title: Create and open a new project from the dashboard
description: Verifies a user can create a named project from the dashboard and land in the project editor with that project loaded.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to create a new project
Fill "Aether Atlas" into the project name field
Save the project
Click the control to open the newly created project
Verify the user lands on the project editor with an active project loaded

title: Require a project name before saving a new project
description: Verifies the user cannot save a new project with a blank name and can save successfully after providing a valid name.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to create a new project
Fill "" into the project name field
Save the project
Fill "Stormglass" into the project name field
Save the project
Verify the user lands on the project editor with an active project loaded

title: Reopen a recent project from the dashboard after returning from editor
description: Verifies a created project appears in the recent list and can be reopened from the dashboard, loading into the editor.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to create a new project
Fill "Iron Vale" into the project name field
Save the project
Click the navigation control to return to the dashboard
Click the recent project entry for "Iron Vale"
Verify the user lands on the project editor with an active project loaded

title: Add two characters, assign a trait, create a relationship, and save
description: Verifies a user can create two characters, assign a trait, define a relationship between them, and save so both the characters and relationship are listed in the project.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to create a new project
Fill "Relations Test" into the project name field
Save the project
Add a new character
Fill "Arin" into the character name field
Save the character
Add a new character
Fill "Bela" into the character name field
Save the character
Open the trait editor flow for character "Arin"
Add a new trait
Fill "Brave" into the trait name field
Save the trait
Return to the project editor
Create a relationship between "Arin" and "Bela"
Select a relationship label
Save changes in the project editor
Verify the project shows both characters and at least one relationship in the project listing

title: Switch between two projects and keep the active project scoped correctly
description: Verifies a user can create two projects and switching between them loads the correct active project in the editor.

steps.description: Navigate to /

Fill "Project One" into the project name field
Save the project
Click the navigation control to return to the dashboard
Click the control to create a new project
Fill "Project Two" into the project name field
Save the project
Click the navigation control to return to the dashboard
Click the recent project entry for "Project One"
Verify the user lands on the project editor with an active project loaded

title: Switch projects and verify characters/relationships remain scoped to the correct project
description: Verifies that after creating characters and a relationship in one project, switching to another project and back preserves the original project data and does not leak it across projects.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to create a new project
Fill "Scoped A" into the project name field
Save the project
Add a new character
Fill "Kai" into the character name field
Save the character
Add a new character
Fill "Mira" into the character name field
Save the character
Create a relationship between "Kai" and "Mira"
Select a relationship label
Save changes in the project editor
Click the navigation control to return to the dashboard
Click the control to create a new project
Fill "Scoped B" into the project name field
Save the project
Click the navigation control to return to the dashboard
Click the recent project entry for "Scoped A"
Verify the project listing shows the previously created characters and relationship for the reopened project

title: Recent projects list shows newly created project on dashboard

Save the project

title: Save a generated and edited map to the active project
description: Ensures a user can generate terrain, edit rivers/lakes, save the map, and later see the same map reloaded for the active project.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Create a new project from the dashboard
Fill a unique project name into the project name field
Save the new project
Click the navigation control to open the map view
Generate terrain for the map
Edit rivers on the map using the available map editing controls
Edit lakes on the map using the available map editing controls
Save the map to the project
Click the navigation control to leave the map view
Click the navigation control to open the map view again
Verify the saved map is loaded for the active project
